import sqlite3
conn = sqlite3.connect('data.sqlite')

# 1) naive_growth from exported transfer_volume values
cur.execute('SELECT period, definition, transfer_volume FROM exports ORDER BY period')
exports = cur.fetchall()
p1_vol = dict(exports)[('P1','largest_eligible_per_tx')][2]
p2_vol = dict(exports)[('P2','all_eligible_events')][2]
naive_growth = (p2_vol - p1_vol) / p1_vol * 100
print(f'Export volumes: P1={p1_vol}, P2={p2_vol}')
print(f'naive_growth = ({p2_vol} - {p1_vol}) / {p1_vol} * 100 = {naive_growth}%')

for period in ['P1', 'P2']:
    cur.execute('SELECT SUM(amount_units) FROM events WHERE period=? AND event_kind NOT IN (\"mint\",\"burn\")', (period,))
    vol = cur.fetchone()[0]
    cur.execute('SELECT COUNT(*) FROM events WHERE period=? AND event_kind NOT IN (\"mint\",\"burn\")', (period,))
    cnt = cur.fetchone()[0]
    print(f'{period} all_eligible_events: sum={vol}, count_events={cnt}')

    print(f'  {row}')

# 3) comparable_growth on all_eligible_events

# P1 all_eligible

p1_all = cur.fetchone()[0]
